ref_text: Good afternoon, and welcome. I'll be looking after you today, so just let me know if you need anything at all.

mia.instruct: A young British woman in her twenties with a standard Southern English, Received Pronunciation accent. Bright, warm and friendly voice, clear articulation, natural conversational pace.

hana.instruct: A British woman in her thirties with a polished Received Pronunciation accent. Polite, composed and precise, slightly formal, very clear diction.

ellie.instruct: A British woman in her late twenties with a soft Southern English accent. Gentle, relaxed and kind, unhurried and warm.

leo.instruct: A British man in his thirties with a standard Southern English, Received Pronunciation accent. Calm, mellow and reassuring low voice, unhurried.

theo.instruct: A young British man in his twenties with a standard Southern English accent. Cheerful, upbeat and energetic, lively intonation.

guide.instruct: A British man in his thirties with a neutral Received Pronunciation accent. Clear, steady and friendly, like a language teacher.
